title: Hearing where a scale lies
description: Highlighted positions and playback help tie the shape to the sound.

blocks.text: Colored dots on the fretboard don’t yet explain which sequence a person is supposed to hear.

quote.text: I'm enjoying this app it has easy fingering and shows you your root notes in each scale!! Plus you've all the modes!!

blocks.text: Tie the chosen position to a note, give slow playback and a repeat of a short passage. Keep the shape the person is working on.
There has to be a way to move from watching to playing it yourself without a constant prompt.
